text: ITR-7 is applicable to persons including trusts, institutions, and political parties required to file returns under sections 139(4A) to 139(4F).
Provide details of the trust or institution including PAN, registration details, and applicable exemption section.
Specify the section under which exemption is claimed, such as section 11, 12, or 10(23C).
Report income applied for charitable or religious purposes during the year.
Provide details of income accumulated or set apart for future application as permitted by law.
Report voluntary contributions received, distinguishing corpus donations where applicable.
If the trust or institution has business income, report it along with compliance with applicable conditions.
Report capital gains arising from transfer of assets held by the trust or institution.
Include income such as interest or other receipts not covered elsewhere.
Enter audit report details as required for trusts and institutions claiming exemption.
Claim eligible deductions and report application of income as per provisions.
Compute tax liability if any, after considering exemptions, accumulation, and applicable rates.
Report tax deducted or collected at source as per certificates and Form 26AS.
Provide bank account details and select one account for refund, if applicable.
Ensure compliance with conditions for claiming exemption, including timely filing and audit requirements.
Verify the return using digital signature or other prescribed methods to complete filing.
The return is invalid unless verification is completed within the prescribed time.
